assignees: ""
---

## The need

Who needs this, and what can they not do today? If it is a banking need, say which role (admin, data scientist, loan operations, relationship manager) it serves.

## The change

What you would like Credora to do.

## Where it would live

Exasol (SQL, Lua, UDF), the backend, the web app, the deploy tool, the mock APIs, or the docs.

## Anything else

Links, examples, or constraints. All data in Credora is synthetic, so examples must be invented too.
